description: A negative AGI never creates a deduction. TY2026 single: wages $90,000, interest $100,000, Schedule C loss $256,000 → AGI −$66,000; state and local taxes $5,000; no medical, casualty or charitable amounts. The 7.5% and 10% floors read the negative AGI as zero, so the medical and casualty deductions are $0 (reading it as negative gave $4,950 and $6,600, 17.5% of $66,000). Itemized deductions $5,000.
